method: Paired WebGPU worlds at matching simulation ages, alternating step order and creation order. Same scene, timestep, iterations, actions and sleeping preset. GPU timestamps surround the complete physics step; drawing is excluded. First 0.2 seconds omitted. Active window: 0.2–2 seconds; later window: final two seconds. Presets require at least 10% total time saved in both repeats and no more than 15% active-time regression. Invalid poses, dropped contacts or solve-group conflicts disqualify a preset.
